timestamp_basis: Observer.models records its then-current /clock as sim_s; ModelStates has no header. wall_unix is callback receipt time, not generation time.
window_selection: Inclusive original CSV samples 20<=sim_s<=140; no T95 truncation or endpoint interpolation
path_definition: sum hypot(x[i]-x[i-1],y[i]-y[i-1]) over original consecutive samples within the window. Sampled polyline estimate, not exact continuous traveled distance.
clock_interval_flag_definition: dt>0.12sim is only an irregular Observer clock-latch interval; not evidence of dropped ModelStates or a stopped robot. Full polyline retained per root review.
segment_definition: Split only at dt>=0.20sim or non-increasing timestamps. None occur in this cohort. No smoothing, coordinate fitting, interpolation, or truth input to policy.

Corr6201.use: Offline plot background only; no recomputation of published coverage or policy input
